notes: Creative track, project hearth-and-horizon, shelf for-other-minds, piece put-her-in. creative_due.py named for-other-minds as due; there were no open creative PRs. Every figure (ten parishes x three age bands, two count weekends, r = 0.977, regression intercept 1.2 and slope 1.09 implying 110%, bounds 0-1 in all ten parishes, robustness margins of 13-16 people in the city and 2-4 in the suburbs, pooled suburbs 7.1/9.1/5.9%) was computed by a scratch script before drafting and checked against the closing note afterwards. The adversarial re-read fixed four things: Mrs Doig was both at the church door and housebound; a Gloria was placed at a Saturday weekday Mass; the bounds were said to narrow in two parishes when they narrow in none; three lines were too close to Six More Chairs. Weekdays checked with datetime. node --test 17/17 in the venture. run_workflow_locally --for-changes: ventures-tests 5/5 run steps passed (3 uses: steps not run); portfolio-validate result recorded in a follow-up commit.
